climate-energy.heading: Protecting Your Rights and Our Democracy
climate-energy.quote: She has fought alongside Governor Pritzker to protect voting rights, safeguard reproductive freedom, stand up for LGBTQ+ rights, tackle the gun violence crisis, and take urgent action on climate change.
climate-energy.note: This is the only mention of climate on her site. The sentence is about her record in Illinois and lists several issues.

priorities.heading: Lower the Cost-of-Living for Working Families
priorities.quote: I will fight to lower the cost-of-living so everyone in our great state can achieve their own version of the American Dream.

priorities.heading: Champion Common Sense Solutions, Not Extreme Agendas
priorities.quote: America needs common sense leadership that puts families first, strengthens our communities, and expands opportunity for the next generation.

priorities.heading: Represent All of Illinois
priorities.quote: Too many of our politicians seem to forget Illinois has 102 counties, and the working families in every county deserve to have their voices heard. I will be proud to bring their voices to the halls of Congress.

cost-of-living.heading: Lower Taxes and Reduce Inflation
cost-of-living.quote: Lower Taxes and Reduce Inflation – Cut wasteful spending, improve efficiency, and help families keep more of what they earn.

housing.heading: Make Housing More Affordable
housing.quote: Make Housing More Affordable – Support policies that expand opportunity and remove barriers that make it harder to build affordable homes.

health-care.heading: Lower Health Care and Drug Costs
health-care.quote: Lower Health Care and Drug Costs – Promote price transparency, more competition, and reforms that help reduce insurance and prescription costs.

immigration.heading: Secure Borders and the Rule of Law
immigration.quote: Secure Borders and the Rule of Law – Enforce immigration laws and oppose taxpayer-funded benefits for those here illegally.

climate-energy.heading: Lower Energy and Utility Costs
climate-energy.quote: Lower Energy and Utility Costs – Support a reasonable energy policy that uses available energy sources, protects reliability, and reduces household costs.
